jobs.title: Agile Product Owner Sr Lead
jobs.description:
Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.

About the team

The Capital Markets Securities Processing is responsible for a number of products that are deployed for processing equities, fixed income, mutual funds and derivatives to sell-side brokers.  These products include Securities Processing Manager (formerly Phase3), PTP (formerly Torstone), Professional Portal (formerly WealthStation), and ancillary modules and have customers around the world with the highest concentration in North America and Europe.

The Product Management function is currently spread across all regions of the world servicing customers globally.  The Team participates in requirements capture, solution design, backlog prioritisation, industry and client engagements.

What you will be doing

The PTP platform is highly extensible and configurable and uses out-of-the-box standardized configurations with per-client custom configuration layers.  End-customer solutions are composed by integrating components with standard capabilities into full solutions which are layered with customer-specific configuration as appropriate.
We are looking to strengthen our team with a Senior Product Manager who will own the Product Roadmap for our Reference Data component suite alongside the roadmap and delivery of PTP’s standard product configuration globally.

The duties or the role include: -
1. Managing the roadmap for all reference data work in PTP globally including but not limited to Security Master and Account Master.
- Facing off to the Dev Team responsible for Reference Data
- Managing Reference Data roadmap
- Refining Epics and Stories for Reference Data
- Defining Acceptance Criteria for Reference Data Management core change

2. Managing the roadmap for all “out-of-the-box” configurations of the platform which includes US, Canadian, Hong Kong, Japanese and European configurations.
- Each solution blueprint defines a number of components that make up the solution, the integration requirement and integration and regression test packs.
- The Product Manager will be responsible for defining the end-to-end component integration requirements for Standard Configurations.
- Working closely with development teams and Solutions Architects to validate designs and establish build plans for integrating components into Solutions.
- Defining acceptance criteria for end-to-end solutions.
- Assisting in the definition of regression and integration testing scenarios for standard configurations.
- Resolving component integration issues and managing dependencies across component product dev plans.

3. Liaising with customer implementation teams to ensure product development deliverables meet both the objectives of the customer projects and of the standardized product
4. Liaising with component development teams to resolve any end-to-end integration issues.
5. Engaging with customers as necessary to ensure that Product Development requirements meet customer and product objectives.
6. Engaging with pre-sales to prioritize pre-sales end-to-end demo requirements.

What you bring:

- A good understanding of Canadian Retail, Institutional and Correspondent Clearing operational processes,
- Experience of securities processing (back-office) both in equities and fixed income in North America and/or Europe.
- A previous career at a broker or Vendor in a Product or Development role in this space.
- Understanding of general functions and departments of Institutional and Retail brokers
- A deep understanding of Security and Account Master integration, usage and challenges
- Significant exposure to processes - Trade Capture and Middle-office
- Settlements
- Corporate Actions

- A previous senior role in Product Management
- Effective communications and interpersonal skills.
- Team worker - able to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels within organization, internally and externally
- Analytical, problem-solving skills

Added bonus if you have:

- Experience of one or more of the following systems: Broadridge BPS, Broadridge Gloss or FIS RIMS
- Experience in Agile development practices
- Exposure to modern development practices: CI/CD projects

What we offer you

- A multifaceted job with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities.
- The opportunity to participate in a long-term strategic re-engineering program of work to bring contemporary technology and development practices to the US Securities Processing industry.
- A modern, international work environment and a dedicated and motivated team
- A competitive salary and benefits

Job Description
FIS Management Services, LLC seeks Agile Product Owner Sr Leads in Jacksonville, FL to lead all product owners and own the end-to-end team execution strategy from inception to production for new features functionality and enhancements. Collaborating with Product Managers to ensure the successful delivery of Zelle and Bill Pay feature functionality to the market. Utilize tools such as Jira, Visio, Microsoft Project and Aha to plan, track, and manage complex projects. Work closely with Product Manager’s to develop product roadmaps, strategies, and timelines that support the modernization of Zelle, including the complete migration of the technology stack to the AWS Cloud, in alignment with the FIS Money Movement Hub Strategy. Oversee the redesign of both upstream and downstream components, including the Zelle front-end, Zelle APIs, backend functionalities, and ACH, Paynet (real-time payment processing) integration. Interface with fraud and risk engines such as IBM Safer Payment or Sardine, to deliver a unified front-end experience for both Retail and Small Business segments. Accountable for the end-to-end delivery of current Zelle and Bill Pay products by
establishing detailed strategies and actionable timelines, as well as facilitating effective stakeholder engagement to communicate the product vision and define critical requirements. Provide guidance and support to Product Owners to deepen their understanding of the product vision, clarify feature functionality, and offer expert assistance during feature grooming sessions. Facilitated PI planning and review sessions with cross-functional teams to drive iterative product improvements. Prioritize product backlog items based on user feedback and organizational objectives. Responsible for maintaining “Keep the Lights On” (KTLO) and Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations within Retail Payments, which includes resource allocation, scheduling, budgeting, risk management, and overall project leadership. Manage end-of-life (EOL) migration activities for retail payments, addressing vulnerabilities, and ensuring all applications meet PCI compliance and uphold robust security protocols. Lead cross-functional product development teams in daily operations, upholding alignment with project goals through advanced expertise in Scaled Agile and Value Stream agile software development methodologies.

REQUIREMENTS : Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field and five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in the job offered or a related occupation: utilizing Zelle and Bill Pay products, including comprehensive knowledge of end-to-end payment processing, customer support and dispute resolution; utilizing IBM Safer Payments payment fraud detection tools; working with payment processing including ACH, real-time payment APIs, and PCI compliance requirements; working with Agile development methodologies, including test automation and product backlog management using tools; and collaborating with cross-functional teams to manage large-scale system migration projects. jobs.title: Senior / Staff Product Manager – Payments
jobs.description:
About the Role
Sits within a newly acquired startup building an AI-enabled, autonomous banking platform for Tier-1 financial institutions within the banking group. The Product Manager is the single-threaded product owner for the Payments component: vision, roadmap, requirements, prioritization, and measurable outcomes from discovery through production adoption. Requires deep UK or US payments expertise, an engineering foundation, and end-to-end ownership of what we build and why. The first assignment is a live Tier-1 bank payments program with a signed-scope deadline. This is not a program- or delivery-management role: client-program orchestration sits with the Forward Deployed team, and engineering owns architecture and implementation.

Key Responsibilities
Payments Strategy & Roadmap
–Own the direction: Define the multi-year Payments strategy and rolling roadmap across UK and US requirements; decide what to build, defer, simplify, reuse, or deprecate.
–Own the scheme calendar: Productize non-discretionary change — Nacha rules, ISO 20022 deadlines, scheme mandates — before it becomes urgent.
–Keep the roadmap on track and define success: STP, success and return rates, latency, availability, reconciliation breaks, onboarding lead time, adoption.

Payments Domain & Client Leadership
–Be the SME: Serve as the internal product authority on how rails, schemes, participants, processors, settlement models, and operating rules work end to end.
–Problem-solve with clients: Join client working sessions to define what to build — whiteboard the actual payment lifecycle, expose missing controls and edge cases, and identify the minimum viable reusable capability.
–Guard the platform: Convert recurring client and field signal into reusable payment primitives, not client-specific forks; countersign any client commitment that binds the roadmap before it is promised.
–Challenge constructively: Push back on clients and internal experts with evidence; document decisions so they stay made.

Technical Product Definition
–Write the contract: Author PRDs and decision documents; define payment APIs, events, data and state models, error semantics, and acceptance criteria.
–Sweat the semantics: Partner with engineering on idempotency, duplicate handling, retries, ordering, cut-offs and value dates, settlement finality, and recovery.
–Own the boundaries: Define product contracts with Ledger, Customer, Reg & Compliance, Orchestration, Reconciliation, Data, and Command Center.
–Respect the split: This role owns what, why, priority, and acceptance criteria; engineering owns architecture, implementation, and estimates.

Required Experience
Payments Expertise
–Deep, hands-on expertise in UK rails (Faster Payments, Bacs, CHAPS, Open Banking) or US rails (ACH/Nacha, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP, CHIPS); near-term roadmap weights UK depth.
–Working command of ISO 20022, settlement and finality, cut-offs and value dates, returns and reversals, exceptions, reconciliation, and scheme onboarding and certification.
–Practical exposure to more than one payment type (instant, batch/ACH, wire, direct debit, cross-border). Strongly preferred: working knowledge of the other market's rails.

Technical Foundation
–4+ years owning a technical product or platform end to end, including at least one taken personally through launch, adoption, and iteration.
–Engineering background or equivalent hands-on record: typically 3+ years building, shipping, and operating production software — not coordinating its delivery.
–Fluent in APIs, event-driven and distributed systems, data and state modeling, reliability, security, and observability; reads architecture diagrams without a translator.

Operating Style
–Strong ownership mindset — owns outcomes, not tasks; a product owner who ships, not a requirements librarian. High agency; writes the playbook when none exists.
–Technically credible and commercially grounded — earns trust with senior engineers, bank product and operations leaders, scheme experts, and risk and compliance teams, and executives. Clear writer: turns complex rules into decisions that are hard to misinterpret.
–AI-native — uses analytics, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows as the default operating mode for discovery, prototyping, documentation, and decisions, not a side experiment.

Impact & Scope
–Direct impact on core banking platforms used by Tier-1 global institutions — starting with a live Tier-1 payments program
–High autonomy and accountability within a small, senior team, paired with a senior engineering lead
–Work shipped directly to production, supporting high-consequence financial transactions

Why This Role
This role offers the autonomy, ownership, and technical depth of a startup, combined with the scale, stability, and long-term impact of FIS. You will define how some of the world's largest banks initiate, move, settle, reconcile, and control money on a next-generation enterprise platform.

Why Join FIS?
- Build next-generation payment capabilities for leading global banks.
- Work in a startup-style environment backed by the scale of FIS.
- Own products that directly support high-value, mission-critical financial transactions.
- Partner with a senior team of engineers, payment experts, and banking leaders.

jobs.description:
Job Description
Role Overview:

The Senior Director, Origination & Underwriting Solutions Management is accountable for the global strategy, financial performance, product management, and delivery execution of the Commercial Lending Origination and Underwriting portfolio. The role owns the end-to-end lifecycle for Loan Origination, Credit Assessment, Underwriting, and related AI-enabled lending capabilities, with responsibility for growth, innovation, client outcomes, and operational excellence across Tier 1 and Tier 2 financial instituti ons globally.

Reporting directly to the SVP, Solution Leader Product, this leader will   operate   as the general manager for the portfolio - balancing market opportunity, customer needs, financial commitments, roadmap priorities, technology modernization, regulatory expectations, and delivery performance.

Position Mandate:

- Own and grow the portfolio as an integrated business, with clear accountability for revenue, profitability, bookings, recurring revenue, investment, client satisfaction, and execution.

- Define a compelling global product vision and translate it into differentiated roadmaps, commercial offers, and measurable business outcomes.

- Lead the full product lifecycle - from market insight and investment choices through build, implementation, adoption, value realization, and ongoing modernization.

- Represent the business with senior client executives and ensure that product and delivery decisions reflect the needs of sophisticated commercial lenders.

- Build and lead a high-performing global team with a culture of accountability, customer focus, innovation, inclusion, and disciplined execution.

K ey Relationships:

The role partners closely with Engineering, Architecture, Sales, Go-to-Market, Professional Services, Client Success, Finance, Marketing, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and regional leadership. Externally, the leader engages heads of Commercial Lending, Credit and Risk, Operations, Technology, and other senior executives at client banks and strategic partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Business and P&L Leadership:

- Own portfolio financial performance, including revenue growth, profitability, bookings, renewals, recurring revenue expansion, investment management, and forecast accuracy.

- Develop and execute annual and multi-year operating plans, growth strategies, investment cases, and portfolio reviews.

- Identify   and pursue expansion opportunities across regions, client segments, deployment models, partnerships, and adjacent capabilities.

- Establish a practical KPI framework covering financial performance, roadmap execution, adoption, quality, delivery, and client outcomes.

- Make disciplined portfolio trade-offs across growth investments, client commitments, modernization, technical debt, compliance, and operational resilience.

P roduct Strategy and Portfolio Management:

- Define and communicate the global vision, strategic positioning, roadmap, pricing, packaging, and lifecycle plans for Loan Origination, Credit Assessment, Underwriting, and related capabilities.

- Translate market, competitor, regulatory, client, and technology insights into clear product priorities and differentiated value propositions.

- Drive a unified end-to-end lending journey, including interoperability with servicing, syndication, distribution, core banking, collateral, data, and partner ecosystems.

- Advance out-of-the-box, SaaS, cloud, configurable, and repeatable product strategies that improve speed to value and scalability.

- Ensure product strategy serves the distinct needs of complex Tier 1 institutions and Tier 2 banks seeking modern, efficient, and scalable lending operations.

D elivery and Operating Excellence:

- Lead end-to-end delivery governance from discovery and business case through release,   implementation   readiness, adoption, and benefit realization.

- Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Services leaders to deliver predictable roadmaps, high-quality releases, scalable implementations, and resilient operations.

- Create transparent governance for prioritization, dependencies, risks, milestones, capacity, and customer commitments.

- Improve repeatability through stronger productization, documentation,   implementation   assets, release readiness, and feedback loops.

- Use operating data and client insight to   identify   delivery friction, improve time to value, and raise portfolio performance.

Client, Market, and Commercial Leadership:

- Serve as executive sponsor for strategic clients, major opportunities, and complex transformation programs.

- Engage senior client stakeholders on   origination   modernization, credit transformation, underwriting operations, AI adoption, risk controls, and digital lending strategy.

- Partner with Sales and Go-to-Market teams on target segments, pipeline development, solution positioning, executive presentations, proposals, and deal strategy.

- Represent the portfolio in client forums, industry events, analyst discussions, advisory boards, and internal executive reviews.

- Build structured mechanisms for co-creation and convert client insight into scalable product value rather than one-off customization.

I nnovation, Data, & AI Leadership:

- Champion responsible use of AI, advanced analytics, automation, and agentic workflows across origination and underwriting.

- Prioritize capabilities that improve decision speed, underwriting consistency, borrower and banker experience, productivity, governance, and control.

- Drive value from capabilities such as automated spreading, AI-assisted credit memos, advanced projections, data validation, portfolio insight, and workflow automation.

- Ensure innovation is delivered with   appropriate transparency , auditability, control, security, and human oversight for regulated lending environments.

P eople and Organizational Leadership:

- Recruit, develop, and   retain   a diverse global team of product, solution, and delivery leaders.

- Set clear goals, decision rights, operating rhythms, and accountability across the organization.

- Coach leaders and build succession, domain depth, commercial acumen, and stronger product management capability.

- Create an environment that encourages constructive   challenge , informed risk-taking, learning, and cross-functional collaboration.

Required Experience:

- 15+ years of leadership experience in commercial lending, banking technology, financial services software, or fintech.

- 10+ years leading product management, solution management, or comparable enterprise software organizations.

- Demonstrated ownership of a material P&L, business unit, or portfolio with measurable growth and profitability accountability.

- Deep knowledge of commercial lending processes, including origination, credit assessment, underwriting, credit risk, approvals, documentation, and operational handoffs.

- Experience serving Tier 1 and Tier 2 financial institutions and navigating complex enterprise buying, implementation, and governance environments.

- Proven ability to lead global, cross-functional teams and deliver through influence across Product, Engineering, Sales, Services, Finance, and regional organizations.

- Executive presence and communication skills   appropriate   for   C-suite clients, senior internal leaders, industry forums, and high-stakes decision making.

P referred Experience:

- Commercial loan origination systems, credit assessment platforms, risk analytics, or commercial lending workflow technology.

- SaaS and cloud transformation, platform modernization, configurable enterprise products, and API-enabled ecosystems.

- AI and machine learning applications in lending, including responsible deployment in regulated environments.

- Global commercial banking markets across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

- Large-scale product transformation, portfolio integration, strategic partnerships, and   operating-model   change.

Measures of Success:
- Delivers sustainable portfolio growth, stronger recurring revenue, and improved profitability.

- Creates a clear, externally credible product strategy and roadmap aligned to priority client segments.

- Improves roadmap predictability, release quality, implementation repeatability, and time to value.

- Expands strategic relationships and adoption across global Tier 1 and Tier 2 banking clients.

- Advances a unified, AI-enabled origination and underwriting experience with strong governance and control.

- Builds a high-performing global organization with clear accountability, strong succession, and trusted cross-functional partnerships.

jobs.description:
Job Description
We are FIS. Our technology powers the world’s economy and our teams bring innovation to life. We champion diversity to deliver the best products and solutions for our colleagues, clients and communities. If you’re ready to start learning, growing and making an impact with a career in fintech, we’d like to know: Are you FIS?

Location: Tri-State area , hybrid

About the role:
In this exciting new opportunity, you'll be responsible for leading the product build for Keystone Reciprocal Deposits, a governed network service that helps banks retain large deposit relationships, support expanded FDIC insurance coverage above $250,000, and reduce operational drag across placement, matching, recalls, reconciliations, reporting, and audit evidence. You'll own product direction, design choices, launch readiness, adoption, pricing inputs, sales enablement, customer feedback loops, and the operating mechanisms that determine whether the product works commercially, not just technically .

About the team:
Our team collaborates with engineers, bank treasury leaders, operations teams, relationship managers, compliance, legal, risk, audit, finance, marketing, sales, and more! We help drive complex products theses into products that customers buy, adopt, operate, and expand.

What you'll be doing:
Product Strategy
- Define the product strategy for Reciprocal Deposits, including MVP scope, founder-bank pilot requirements, scale path, and commercial readiness gates.
- Build the roadmap for allocation, reciprocal matching, capacity management, recall orchestration, settlement evidence, reporting, pricing telemetry, and support workflows.
- Partner with GTM and Commercial teams to define founder-bank selection, network viability assumptions, and adoption path across priority FIS core clients.

Product Execution
- Write high-quality PRDs, launch plans, operating requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and decision memos.
- Own requirements for customer enrollment, bank onboarding, depositor exclusions, insurance cap enforcement, bank capacity profiles, allocation logic, and reciprocal matching.
- Build product mechanisms for evidence: allocation reports, matching records, audit logs, exception histories, settlement outputs, and compliance exports.

Commercial Ownership and Product Marketing
- Own the commercial success model for Reciprocal Deposits, including target customer segments, adoption path, packaging assumptions, pricing inputs, usage telemetry, and success metrics.
- Define positioning, value proposition, buyer narratives, competitive framing, launch messaging, sales enablement, demo flows, and customer proof points with GTM and Marketing.
- Convert product capabilities into customer-ready artifacts, including pitch materials, implementation narratives, FAQs, objection handling, pilot success criteria, and release communications.

Customer and Market Leadership
- Engage directly with bank treasury, operations, compliance, relationship management, CIO, and payments leaders.
- Translate bank operating realities into scalable product capabilities, not one-off implementation commitments.
- Validate user workflows for treasury teams, bank operations, relationship managers, compliance, audit, and FIS/Keystone operations.

Technical Product Leadership
- Partner deeply with engineering and architecture on allocation services, matching logic, ledger semantics, APIs, event orchestration, identity, RBAC, maker/checker controls, audit logging, and operational tooling.
- Own product decisions around net versus gross settlement evidence, ledger versus off-ledger accounting records, batch versus intraday processing, and exception/fallback handling.

Operational and Regulatory Readiness
- Define product controls for pass-through recordkeeping support, reciprocal classification support, thresholds, exclusions, default handling, disclosures, and audit evidence.
- Drive launch readiness for roles, limits, bank setup, settlement tests, monitoring, DR, support runbooks, escalation paths, and exception management.

What you bring (required):
- 8+ years of product management experience.
- Experience building platform, infrastructure, banking, payments, treasury, deposit, or financial technology products.
- Experience working directly with engineering teams on highly technical systems.
- Experience managing cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, legal, compliance, operations, support, finance, and GTM stakeholders.
- Strong written communication skills, including PRDs, decision memos, launch plans, and executive-ready narratives.
- Demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguous, regulated, and high-stakes environments.
- Experience owning product outcomes beyond delivery, including adoption, GTM readiness, customer feedback loops, pricing inputs, launch metrics, or commercial performance.

What you bring (highly preferred):
- Reciprocal deposits, brokered deposits, sweep products, insured cash products, treasury management, or liquidity products.
- Deposit operations, core banking, Cash Manager or cash management platforms, reconciliation, statements, GL posting, or settlement operations.

- Tokenized deposits, digital assets, stablecoins, or distributed ledger infrastructure.
